newsitem.title: USA: US Midcontinent Group diffs firm on refiner buying.
newsitem.headline: US Midcontinent Group diffs firm on refiner buying.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent spot unleaded gasoline and diesel fuel differentials firmed in Group Three on refiner buying, traders said on Tuesday.
Talk of a catalytic cracker down at Farmland Industries Inc's 68,600 barrel per day Coffeyville, Kansas refinery fueled a modest surge in Group differentials on prompt barrels, traders said.
The outage was expected to last for up to two weeks and halved crude throughput at the key Group Three refinery, traders said.
Group Three prompt unleaded gasoline differentials firmed to even to 0.25 cents a gallon over the print, with premium 2.75 cents higher.
Group Three low sulphur diesel was talked 1.75/2.0 cents a gallon over the print for prompt September barrels, with a deal heard done as high as 2.10 cents over.
Chicago late-September unleaded gasoline differentials firmed to 1.0/0.75 cent under the print with premium talked 3.0 cents higher.
Chicago low sulphur diesel fuel eased to 0.50/0.75 cent a gallon over the print.
High sulphur was discussed even to the print in Group Three and 0.75 cent under the print in Chicago.
Jet/kero was talked 2.25/2.50 cents a gallon in Group Three and 0.25 cent higher in Chicago.
